format: All Competition OS event types (including Studio/Custom)
requirement: For initial Competition OS activation no competitor under 18 may be registered. Every entry participant is checked server-side from a required, valid date of birth; a missing or invalid date of birth fails closed; the purchaser is never the subject of the check; no birthdate or age is returned or logged. Temporary launch restriction, not a permanent exclusion.
enforcement_point: Server: POST /api/events/[slug]/competition/checkout, before quote_competition_registration and start_competition_registration. No database-level guard exists (separate SQL approval, see PR description).

tests.name: fails closed when a competitor has no, malformed or impossible date of birth
the checkout route evaluates the age gate before its first database call (quote, then start)

interpretation_notes: DanceFlow launch policy by owner decision OD-02 (2026-11-23); never presented as a governing-body requirement. Verified at the app layer only: the database RPCs still accept any date of birth, so a caller who reaches the database directly with the service role bypasses the gate. Reference date is today in UTC-12 (conservative), not the event date: a 17-year-old who turns 18 before the event is still refused. The owner may relax this.
